; The semantic control for block-names: the two successors of the conditional
; branch are swapped, and their contents differ, so the program differs.
define i32 @f(i1 %c) {
entry:
  br i1 %c, label %if.else, label %if.then

if.then:
  br label %join

if.else:
  br label %join

join:
  %r = phi i32 [ 11, %if.then ], [ 22, %if.else ]
  ret i32 %r
}
